comment: Dr. Delers is clearly very passionate about film, and that made his class super fun and engaging. Discussion heavy, but allows it to be guided both by his questions and what students want to discuss. He is caring, always accessible for questions, and gives great feedback on assignments.

Classes were always amazing and thoughtful. Be prepared to think deeply about things and share your opinions. He's a great guy and very approachable. My fav prof so far. He's reasonable and makes you want to work hard without being harsh. If you care and do your best, you'll have no problem. No tests but lots of papers. Would recommend 100%
Delers is a really nice guy, and he's super open to hearing what students think. He genuinely cares about his students, and it shows.
The best French Professor at the university

dr delers's great filmmakers of the world was such a fun fys course, you can tell he really cares about what he is teaching and always had well-organized lecture slides alongside interesting discussion questions. I would highly recommend taking any class with him, he is such a wonderful prof!

Reading to Live was one of the most enjoyable classes I have taken! The class is mostly just discussing the books that we are reading with student-led presentations. Very relaxed environment where you can get to know your classmates. 100% recommend taking this SSIR

Fun class, lenient grader, patient and understanding if need more time. Read / watched lots of great books and movies and we covered common grammar mistakes as part of his teaching. 3 essays, open-note midterm, mini presentations, participation, and a teamwork assignment make up the grade. Great prof and looking forward to another class with him.

Fantastic prof. Patient, easy grader, always willing to offer extensions and meet with students. Highly recommend for an SSIR - he is easily one of my favorite professors at Richmond. He teaches a lot of French classes so be sure to take him in that department if you can, as well. Should be an easy A and you will enjoy every minute of his class.

Took his 402 course abroad in La Rochelle. Great prof, not lots of work assigned, overall easy class. Included grammar and phonetics the course to make us sound more like native French speakers. Very knowledgeable about class topics and always willing to talk to students. Can't recommend him highly enough, be sure to take one of his classes.

Amazing professor. Wants to see his students succeed, learn, and enjoy course content. Very interactive w/ heavy emphasis on class discussion and participation. There were three 1000+ word essays, no final exam, a very short midterm, and a final project. Easy grader and feedback is helpful. Overall, really fun class and I definitely recommend.
Great professor. Covers vocab, grammar, and conversation. Really caters the course to students so you can get whatever you want out of it. We watched some fun movies too.

One of my favorite teachers at UR because I feel like I learn so much in his class. Will call students out if you are not participating, so make sure to do the homework by class because participation is huge. Lots of smaller writings rather than a large final essay, which is good.
Dr. Delers is one of the best professors at UR. Hes so caring, attentive, and very knowledgeable. Would take him 1000x!

The best fys professor. He is always ready to help and very respectful of students and their busy schedules. The only work is to watch movies and write a paper every now and then that he helps you with. He is one of the nicest professors I've had at school and made this class way more interesting and engaging than I believed it would be.
Learned a lot about postmodernism and france. Olivier is my role model for life.
Good texts and discussion!
He's the best so cool I aspire to be like him everyday when i wake up I think to myself What would Olivier do today???? and that's how I start my day
don't take. bad professor. gives unnecessary work and is not willing to help much and grading is very very subjective.
Made us stay after for 45 minutes. A lot of pointless work. Not very open to new ideas

This is one of the best classes I've ever taken. Delers was super helpful and entertaining in class, and he continues to be helpful in the French program even though I do not currently have him as a professor. All around wonderful person, highly recommend him.

Prof. Delers is THE BEST! He's super nice and is not too tough of a grader. In 305 we didn't have any tests, just a few vocab quizzes. The course is pretty writing intensive, but again, he's a pretty lenient grader and it will help your writing a lot.

He is a really nice guy, and he's always willing to help out if needed.  He cares about his students doing well, and he wants his classes to be fun.  I highly recommend.  It's not hard to get a good grade in his class as long as you try.

Best teacher for French you can have. Explains everything clearly. OUtside of French, he also teaches great classes in English, and can really develop your writing skills. He is also a very nice guy who will help you with anything.

Incredibly understanding, accessible, and helpful. You'll have to write quite a bit for each class, but overall he makes every on-class discussion really interesting. He'll give you personalized attention to improve your accent and french in general. He's someone you can always talk to in case anything happens. Do take his classes.

After a year off of French, I was unsure about going back, but Delers made it easy. He goes to great lengths to make sure his students understand what they need to do, how things work, and is over-all extremely helpful. I am looking forward to taking another one of his classes.

Professor Delers is a great guy, I took his French Cinema class and though I thought the movies were dreadfully boring I enjoyed the class There are some writing assignments which are hard to get higher than an 89 no matter what you write. There is a good amount of work but he's available for extra help. Hardest part was staying awake during movies

I came into college DREADING french. I took Oliver's intermediate french class just because I had to fulfill the requirment but it turned into my favorite class. I decided to take his cinema class and I liked that one even more! Oliver is the type of teacher where I felt bad not doing his assignments or skipping class. He's just a nice guy.
take this dude, good guy, easy
Really nice guy, very easy. the french conversation through cinema is a really easy class, but useful-there is a lot of in class discussion, but you don't feel pressured to participate.

Delers is a great teacher! I took his French conversation through cinema class, which was great. He is very encouraging about speaking in class and doesn't make you feel stupid if you can't speak French that well. I woud reccommend this class to anyone who wants to work on their conversation skills.
